_note: LIMA peer-mentor content. Everything in 'resources', 'events', and 'crisis' is SAMPLE text written for testing. LLC staff must review and replace it with verified, current information before any session with students.
disclosure: Before we start, a few things you should know.
I'm a robot, not a counselor. I keep a written transcript of this conversation so your Peer Mentor or LLC staff can read it.
After they review it, the transcript is deleted from me. I only keep a few things you choose to tell me, like your classes and hobbies, so I can remember you next time.
If you tell me something that makes me worried about your safety, I will let LLC staff know right away.
You can say or type skip to pass on a question, or stop to end at any time.
declined: No problem at all. I won't keep anything from this conversation. Your Peer Mentor is always happy to talk with you in person.
goodbye: Thanks for checking in with me, {name}. Take care, and see you next time!

message: Thank you for telling me. What you're feeling matters, and you deserve support from a person right now.
If you are in danger or thinking about hurting yourself, please call or text 988, the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, any time, day or night. In an emergency, call 911.
I'm letting the LLC staff know right now so someone can check in with you.
crisis.after: Would you like to keep talking with me while you wait, or stop here?

followup_message: Thank you for sharing that. I'll make a note so your Peer Mentor can follow up with you. You don't have to handle this alone.

counseling.name: Counseling and Psychological Services (CAPS)
counseling.text: Counseling and Psychological Services, called CAPS, offers counseling for IU students. Your Peer Mentor can help you get connected.

tutoring.name: Tutoring and academic support
tutoring.text: Free tutoring is available on campus, including tutoring at Teter. Going to your instructor's office hours early is one of the best ways to get unstuck.

advising.name: Academic advising
advising.text: Your Luddy academic advisor is the right person for questions about dropping a class, your degree, or how a change affects your scholarship. I don't know scholarship rules, so please check with them before you decide.

community.name: LLC community and events
community.text: The LLC hosts events where you can meet people, and your Peer Mentor knows about clubs and smaller, quieter get-togethers too.
